# Perplexity API changelog + API reference — captured 2026-08-24   Tier: watching
# https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog       (in sources.json)
# https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference   (in sources.json)

## NO CHANGE ON EITHER. Nothing above the watching-tier bar.

## Changelog — August 2026 is still MODELS ONLY (unchanged from the 08-21 capture)
- google/gemini-3.7-flash                      ($0.375 / $0.0375 cached / $1.875 per M tokens)
- xai/grok-4.6                                 (Agent API; xAI flagship reasoning/agentic model)
- perplexity/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b        ($0.25 in|cached / $2.50 out per M)
- perplexity/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b    (open-weight reasoning, tiered pricing)
- perplexity/deepseek-v4-flash-0731            (1M-token context)
- Prompt caching for PRESETS.
- Agent API **fast preset** now uses `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` with minimal reasoning + priority
  processing, applied automatically to dynamic requests.
Held from 08-23: the `defer_loading` flag that keeps MCP TOOL DEFINITIONS OUT OF INITIAL CONTEXT —
worth remembering as a discovery hazard (declared tools may not be in the visible context window).

## API reference — endpoint surface IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 cache
Single primary endpoint: **POST /v1/agent** (canonical since March 2026; migrated off
/v1/chat/completions).
Capabilities unchanged: web search with domain/date/recency filters; `fetch_url`; finance search;
people search; **SANDBOX CODE EXECUTION**; custom function tools with JSON Schema; multi-turn via
`previous_response_id`; SSE streaming (14+ event types with intermediate tool output for search,
fetch, finance, people, sandbox, MCP) and async background execution with polling; research loops up
to **100 steps**; **external MCP server integration** with tool discovery; **managed connectors**;
**Skills** — built-in Office document generation (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) plus custom inline skills;
reasoning effort minimal..max; JSON-schema structured output; model fallback chains up to 5;
token/cache accounting and per-operation cost tracking.

Model additions on an existing API surface remain below the reporting bar for a watching-tier
platform (consistent with 08-14, 08-21 and 08-23).

Updated: 2026-08-24 — no finding. Endpoint surface re-verified unchanged.
